verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch supports self-hosting on your own infrastructure with 'full data ownership' and on-prem deployment (Enterprise), which indirectly lets users control where their data resides by choosing their own hosting location, rather than offering explicit region-selection within a managed cloud service. missing for 10: an explicit region/residency selector in the hosted Hoppscotch Cloud offering, and independent confirmation of data-location controls.
